products.name: Rose Bloom Candle
products.description: A hand-poured soy candle sculpted into a single blooming rose, finished with a soft rose and peony fragrance. Each petal is shaped by hand, so no two candles are exactly alike. Burns for approximately 18 hours and makes a stunning centerpiece even before it's lit.

products.name: Macaron Tower Candle Set
products.description: Six pastel, macaron-shaped candles stacked into a playful centerpiece. Made from a soft vanilla-scented wax blend, they're just as lovely displayed on a dessert table as they are lit for a cozy evening. Sold as a set of six mixed colors.

products.name: Apollo Bust Candle
products.description: Inspired by classical Greco-Roman sculpture, this bust-shaped pillar candle brings a museum-worthy accent to any shelf or mantel. Carved in warm ivory wax with a lightly textured finish, it burns slowly from the crown down, revealing the sculpture beneath the flame.

products.name: Antique Bronze Bust Candle
products.description: A moodier take on our classical bust candle, finished with warm bronze undertones and deeper shadow detailing in the hair and features. A striking statement piece for a reading nook or fireplace mantel.

products.name: Guardian Angel Candle
products.description: A serene angel bust with delicately carved wings, hand-poured in soft ivory wax. A favorite for the winter holidays, it makes a thoughtful gift for anyone who could use a little extra light this season.

products.name: Teddy Bear Candle
products.description: A playful soy wax teddy bear candle in a deep lavender hue, scented with calming lavender and chamomile. Loved as a nursery decoration or a gentle gift for candle lovers of any age.

products.name: Winter Wonderland Candle Collection
products.description: A curated collection of miniature holiday-shaped candles — little houses, pine trees, a pinecone, and a reindeer — cast in a warm beeswax blend. Arranged together they make an instant festive tablescape; lit one by one, each burns for 6 to 10 hours.

products.name: Coastal Pillar Candle Set
products.description: A textured set of geometric and shell-inspired pillar candles in soft neutral tones, designed to be grouped together for a gallery-shelf look. Unscented, so the natural soy-beeswax blend never competes with your home fragrance.

products.name: Wrapped Gift Candle Trio
products.description: Three petite candles wrapped in kraft paper and tied with raffia, ready to gift without a single extra step. Each one is a different botanical blend, so the recipient gets a mini discovery set of our best-loved scents.

products.name: Fluted Pillar Candle Collection
products.description: Deeply ribbed pillar candles in warm oak and soft ivory, cast in a variety of heights to build an editorial-style candle display. Unscented and slow-burning, made to be restyled again and again.

products.name: Stone Jar Soy Candle
products.description: Our best-selling everyday candle: 100% soy wax poured into a matte reusable stoneware jar with a fitted lid. Clean-burning and gently scented with cedar and sea salt, it's designed to dust off and refill once the wax runs low.

products.name: Cube Duo Candle Set
products.description: Two minimalist cube candles — one warm ivory, one soft charcoal — cast from a dense pillar wax that keeps their crisp edges as they burn. A quietly modern addition to any console table or bookshelf.

products.name: Sculptural Pebble Stack Candle
products.description: An architectural candle arrangement inspired by stacked river stones, paired with a tall fluted pillar. Each piece burns independently, so you can rearrange the set as the candles wear down.

products.name: Ribbed Wood-Base Candle Set
products.description: A collection of ribbed soy candles paired with a hand-thrown ceramic bud vase, finished on natural wood risers. A calm, earthy display for anyone who loves the wabi-sabi look.

products.name: Pastel Seashell Candle Set
products.description: Four shimmering, shell-shaped candles in peach, blush, seafoam, and sky blue, finished with a fine glitter dust for extra shine. A sweet nod to summer that looks just as good year-round.

products.name: Rose Bloom Candle - Mini
products.description: The mini version of our signature rose candle, sized for gifting or for filling a smaller space with fragrance. Same hand-shaped petals, same rose and peony scent, in a more compact 6cm bloom.

products.name: Apollo Bust Candle - Large Edition
products.description: A larger-scale version of our Apollo bust candle, nearly double the height of the original, for anyone who wants their classical centerpiece to make an even bigger statement.

products.name: Cube Duo Candle Set - Travel Size
products.description: A compact, travel-friendly version of our cube duo, perfectly sized for a nightstand, office desk, or carry-on. Same two-tone pairing, scaled down without losing the sharp geometric silhouette.

products.name: Stone Jar Soy Candle - Refill
products.description: A wax-only refill for our Stone Jar Soy Candle, made to be poured into your existing jar once the first candle burns down. The sustainable way to keep the same reusable jar in rotation for years.

products.name: Pastel Seashell Candle - Mini Set
products.description: A petite version of our shell candle set, sized for a bathroom shelf, gift bag, or as a little something extra with a larger order. Includes two mixed pastel shells.
